Entry Crowns and Coronations The crown condenses lineage, recognition, and ritual into visible metal. Gems and styles can suggest dynasties, beliefs or personal ambitions, but what really determines their weight is the person who is willing to kneel; an ownerless crown is just a precious piece of jewelry, and only a recognized crown can be worn by orders. A past war or a dynastic change will determine today's tax rates, covenants, roads and who has the right to speak first in the hall.

Entry Crowns and Coronations The crown condenses lineage, recognition, and ritual into visible metal. Gems and styles can suggest dynasties, beliefs or personal ambitions, but what really determines their weight is the person who is willing to kneel; an ownerless crown is just a precious piece of jewelry, and only a recognized crown can be worn by orders. They remember which flag fell, which bridge was burned, and who shared the last sip of water in the snow; for them, history is first and foremost the memory left by the body.

The winner will write it as a proof of order, the loser will keep it as a warning, and ordinary people will only remember how much the price of food and cemeteries increased that year.
